summary.text: Larry Satcowitz is a Democratic state representative from the Orange-Washington-Addison district who has served in the Vermont House of Representatives since January 2021 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Larry Satcowitz earned a B.A. in philosophy from the University of Pennsylvania and an M.S. in zoology from Colorado State University.
His career experience includes working as a high school math teacher, a landscaper, and a database programmer.
Satcowitz assumed office in the Vermont House on January 6, 2021, succeeding Peter Reed.
Ballotpedia lists his 2021 through 2024 committee assignment as the Natural Resources, Fish, and Wildlife Committee.
